evidence: Walked the brief and all three /instructions notes line by line against the frozen reference; every asked-for screen, role and flow has an implementation. Sign-in-only shell (index.html #signin, app.js boot/showSignin; server requireUser on every /api route, transcript 401). Walls: canSee/visibleMatter gate the list, thread, search, mentions (mentionsFor filter), previews (previewsFor -> available:false), people suggestions, read, versions and transcript (server.js 189-200, 226-235, 320-345, 497-505); partner add/lift walls (server.js 479-490, app.js renderWalls); open thread drops to 'Not available' via 2 s polling (app.js 640-651, showUnavailable). Retention: per-matter timer off/1/7/30 with label beside title, partner-only, sweep uses age >= timer, shortening sweeps immediately, edits keep original 'at' (server.js 139-147, 467-477). Holds: partner-only, exact message, blocks delete, release sweeps at once, 'On hold' badge separate from body text (server.js 452, 457-465; app.js 310). Threads: unlimited depth, children in seq order, parent quote or 'deleted' placeholder, same-matter parent check (server.js 253-291, 405-411). Edits: author-only, 'edited', staff-only versions, version-checked 409 that keeps composer text, inline delete confirm with 'Keep it' (server.js 427-455; app.js 338-345, 474-493). Formatting: escape-first *bold*, `code`, '> ' quote, http(s) links with target=_blank; textContent/esc in quotes, snippets, versions, transcript (app.js 23-55, 548; server.js 494-517). Links: Copy link box, previews per viewer, /messages/:id opens thread with persistent .focused highlight. Mentions: first-name case-insensitive, only visible people, recomputed on edit and cleared on delete, @ suggestions from /people, Mentions view with count. Unread: server-side per-user positions, new-messages line, read on open, Mark unread from any message, deleted excluded. Enter/Shift+Enter/Escape, client_key idempotent sends, seq ordering in thread/search/transcript, polling preserves composer, scroll and open versions. Runtime: __dirname paths, DB_PATH, 0.0.0.0:3000, health 200 before DB check, seed copy byte-identical to /assets (sha b256f85e...), import once via settings.seeded, no symlinks or app.db in solution. Transcript: header with matter id/title/generated time, threaded oldest first, author/time/edited/hold, versions for held edited, placeholder, no controls. Phone: 720px media query; scripted golden asserts scrollWidth <= innerWidth at 390. Supporting run evidence: raw-evidence-index entries whose matching_source_files hashes equal the frozen solution bytes (re-verified) show qc/repairs/kittle-2026-10-08 scripted Playwright golden passing all 16 functional checks, constraints-gate steps, persistence across a real restart and six polish checks (functional-before/after.json, golden-run.log). Weak-app probe: an app that only renders formatting client-side but leaks walled previews/mentions, or that lacks Mark unread/versions UI, would lack a deliverable the reference does implement; a conforming alternative (e.g. SSE instead of polling, modal confirm, separate thread pane) is not contradicted by anything the reference hard-codes for this row. Minor Note (not a defect): transcript and reply quotes render bodies as escaped plain text without bold/link formatting; the brief only requires markup to show as typed there and calls the transcript a plain reading page. Scripted golden is not a configured judge run or Oracle score, but this row asks only whether the reference plausibly covers every deliverable.
